item.title: Seattle bracing for stormy weather, more flooding
item.description: Multiple rounds of heavy rain and wind are expected Monday through Wednesday. Power outages and tree damage are possible.

item.title: Over 30k lose power as strong winds hit western WA
item.description: Thousands are dealing with power outages across the Puget Sound as strong winds swept through the area Monday.

item.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup price structures for Seattle, Vancouver, BC revealed
item.description: With exactly six months until the first Seattle game of the FIFA World Cup in 2026, here are the pricing structures for tickets in the Emerald City along with neighboring Vancouver, BC.

item.title: Snoqualmie, WA ski resort offering season pass rollover for late year start
item.description: With Washington ski resorts still struggling to open for the season due to a lack of snow, some like the Summit at Snoqualmie are offering a rollover opportunity with a Monday deadline.

item.title: 'Muddy mess': Pierce County, WA RV park residents continue flood clean-up
item.description: Residents at an RV park near Orting are struggling to rebuild after rapid flooding from the Puyallup River damaged or destroyed dozens of trailers, displacing more than 100 people.

item.title: Offensive struggles continue for Seattle Seahawks as playoffs loom
item.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald would prefer not to have to rely on Jason Myers quite so much. His team needed six field goals from Myers to pull out an 18-16 win over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday.

item.title: Bender promotes "One Big Give" Seattle Children's Radiothon, talks Seahawks and does trivia!
item.description: Jodi and Bender from 95.7 The Jet will be holding their annual radiothon to raise money for the Seattle Children's uncompensated care fund on Tuesday. Donations can be made online at www.GiveToTheKids.com. Bender also took part in Aaron's trivia segment, "On The Clock."

item.title: Everett, WA man sentenced to 5 years for bombing Black neighbors' car
item.description: A 55-year-old Everett, Washington man who blew up a Black couple's car with a pipe bomb was sentenced to five years in prison.

item.title: Harrison Bertos golden goal in OT gives Washington men's soccer first national championship
item.description: Harrison Bertos scored the golden goal for the Washington Huskies in the second minute of overtime to give UW its first men's soccer national championship with a 3-2 victory over North Carolina State.

item.title: WA Weather: More heavy rain, gusty winds and mountain snow by Tuesday night
item.description: Flood Watches and Warnings remain in effect across Western Washington as heavy rain continues to push river levels higher.
